name: omp-warden
description: A configurable model-classifier gate for oh-my-pi (omp) tool calls, layered on omp's native approval.

enabled.description: Turn the classifier gate on or off. When off, omp's native approval decides alone.

judgeRole.description: omp model role whose model scores stage 1 (a native judge, e.g. a local tiny model).

llmRole.description: omp model role whose chat model decides the stage-2 fallback.

onNoAnswer.description: What to do when neither stage can answer (model down, timeout, or not a judge).
